name: vol_surface_signal_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, the ratio of ATM put premium to ATM call premium tracks real-time intraday directional order flow between market participants. When institutions or hedgers aggressively buy puts for short-term protection, ATM PE premiums spike relative to ATM CE premiums, pushing the PE/CE ratio significantly above its 20-minute session baseline. At a 2-sigma intraday extreme, this put-buying burst has typically exhausted available demand — the feared event hasn't materialized — and NIFTY tends to recover over the next 30-90 seconds as market makers delta-hedge by purchasing index futures. Symmetrically, extreme call-buying (ratio z-score below -2sigma) signals bullish exhaustion as speculative call demand wanes, creating a short-term bearish fade opportunity.
core_signal_oneliner: ATM put-to-call premium ratio z-score exceeds 2-sigma over 20-minute baseline, signaling directional demand exhaustion
